title: Fennel Courtyard
description: A–C–B–G, borrowed from the second phrase of Fennel Parallax, returns as a singing lower refrain. Its three-bar cycle meets seven-bar upper phrases, changing the meeting points between the hands. The middle opens towards F and D major; the final lower refrain is shortened and leaves a quiet A-minor ninth.
difficulty: Advanced seven-beat counterpoint and independent phrase lengths
technical_note: Let the LH refrain sing, especially in bars 1, 4, 7 and 10. Its repeated three-bar span should not dictate the RH seven-bar phrases. The final refrain in bar 19 loses its last long note, making room for the closing two bars.

performance.note: The melody below and the song above should breathe independently. Preserve the upper phrase across lower returns, then let the final two bars expand into stillness.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
